aa-judson.title: Thomas W. Judson, Abstract Algebra: Theory and Applications (author book homepage)
aa-judson.notes: Groups, homomorphisms, group actions, cosets, elementary number theory, rings and fields.

aa-mit701.title: Michael Artin, MIT OCW 18.701 Algebra I (Fall 2010)
aa-mit701.notes: Group axioms, generators, homomorphisms, cosets, quotients, and actions.

aa-mit701-notes.title: MIT OCW RES.18-011 Algebra I Student Notes (Fall 2021)
aa-mit701-notes.notes: Group actions, orbit–stabilizer counting, and worked algebraic examples.

aa-mit6042.title: MIT OCW 6.042J, Mathematics for Computer Science (Spring 2015)
aa-mit6042.notes: Divisibility, greatest common divisors, modular arithmetic and elementary counting.

aa-conrad.title: Keith Conrad, Expository Papers (University of Connecticut)
aa-conrad.notes: Modules, ideals, minimal polynomials, splitting fields, and other algebraic constructions.

aa-mit702.title: Michael Artin, MIT OpenCourseWare 18.702 Algebra II, Spring 2011, course readings
aa-mit702.notes: Finite fields, splitting fields, Galois groups, intermediate fields, cubic and quintic equations.

aa-etingof.title: Pavel Etingof et al., Introduction to Representation Theory, MIT OCW 18.712 lecture notes
aa-etingof.notes: Representations, semisimplicity and Maschke theorem, characters and orthogonality, tensor products.

aa-mit-homological.title: Kiran Kedlaya, Homological Algebra, MIT OCW 18.726 Algebraic Geometry Lecture 16 (Spring 2009)
aa-mit-homological.notes: Exact sequences, chain complexes, and derived functors.

aa-weibel.title: Charles A. Weibel, An Introduction to Homological Algebra (Cambridge University Press, 1994)
aa-weibel.notes: Projective resolutions, derived functors, Tor and Ext.
